name: Mega Lokix
description1: Its folded set of legs have transformed into powerful blades that can cut through steel. It can strike with blinding speed and precision.
description2: With its newfound power, it challenges all who stand in its way. It feels no need to hide in the shadows and strikes without mercy.

name: Xeno Tyranitar
description1: If its wounded in any way, it can regrow the wounded parts to be stronger. Eventually, it can become impossible to defeat.
description2: Its old shell is broken from its rapidly-mutating body forcing it apart. Tyranitar is in constant pain from this and lashes out indiscriminately.

name: Xeno Scizor
description1: Its liquid-chrome body conceals a superheated furnace core. It manipulates its molten-steel limbs into terrifying weaponry, crushing targets with cold, mechanical precision.
description2: A hyper-dense bio-mechanical hunter. Its molten core fuels its morphing limbs, making it virtually indestructible in close combat.
